note: Falls County is a general-law county with no zoning authority over unincorporated land or cities (texasstateauthority.com; propertychecker.com). The county publishes no zoning layer. The largest city, Marlin, publishes its zoning map only as a static PDF (marlintx.net/zoning-map/), and its zoning appendices are web text. No ArcGIS REST or GIS zoning district layer was found for Falls County or Marlin, Rosebud, Lott, Chilton or Golinda. Regrid and Zoneomics hold third-party copies only.
